Corridor Descriptions
Corridor #1 - begins at its westerly end from an interchange located on I-94 at Grange Avenue. This access interchange to I-94 would be located one mile north of the College Avenue interchange and one mile south of the directional interchange at Layton Avenue. It would consist of suitable entrance and exit ramps designed to provide access directly onto Grange Avenue.
Proceeding to the east of I-94, the corridor would be confined to 110 feet of right of way by following the centerline alignment of existing Grange Avenue to 6th Street and then northeasterly to east of Howell Avenue for a total of approximately 1.66 miles. The alignment would be north of the new air cargo area.
The air terminal facilities of General Mitchell Field would be accessible from Howell Avenue since the airport entrance road is located north of Grange Avenue on Howell Avenue.
The land usage along Grange Avenue from 20th Street to Howell Avenue is currently in transition from agricultural to residential and light industrial use. From 20th Street to 13th Street, the area is primarily single family residential. In the vicinity of 13th Street the development is multi-family residential. From 13th Street east to the C.M. St. P. & P. Railroad the land use is zoned light industry but is currently used as truck storage yards. East of the railroad to 6th Street the limited wood land areas are rapidly disappearing in favor of residential and commercial development.
Milwaukee County is presently in the process of implementing their Master Plan for General Mitchell Field's airport terminal expansion program and has acquired the lands east of 6th Street and north of Grange Avenue for the development of a new 60 acre air cargo area.
